events.text: Francis Drake completes his circumnavigation of the world.
New Zealand becomes a dominion of the British Empire.
The ocean liner RMS Queen Mary is launched in Scotland.
The musical West Side Story opens on Broadway.
Kennedy and Nixon take part in the first televised U.S. presidential debate.
Soviet officer Stanislav Petrov correctly judges a missile alert to be false, averting nuclear war.
Britain and China agree on the return of Hong Kong to China in 1997.

births.text: Manmohan Singh, Prime Minister of India
